title: The invariant: no live session without a live key, none begun at or before the mark
assertion: Over a sign-in, a removal's confirmation, End membership and a reset on one account, on two connections in each order of the account's lock, the second seen waiting on the first: a sign-in that holds the lock first is ended by whichever of the three waited for it; a sign-in begun before one of them and waiting on it is refused when it commits (user_session_hardware_key_live after a confirmation, user_session_sign_in_not_before after the other two); a sign-in begun after its clock and before its commit is refused after a confirmation and opens after the other two only because its key is live; any two of the three in either order leave no session, and a step begun before them opens none; after each, no live session of the account has a digest that is not a live key of it and none began at or before the mark. Resolving a session issues the statements it issued before the registry (BEGIN, the one resolving statement, COMMIT: three, one read), for a key session and a code session alike, and the registry's migrations do not name resolve_session
noFileReason: Synthetic personas and keys the tests make in memory (a software authenticator, a provider twin); no file.
